info.title: Mendwire check history API (focused contract)
info.description: Documents only the existing read-only check history operation. It is not a complete Mendwire API specification.

get.summary: List check history for an owned monitor
get.description: Requires a signed-in session and access to the monitor's workspace. Returns at most 50 runs, newest first. The optional opaque cursor is limited to 512 URL-safe characters and is valid only for the same monitor.

404.description: The monitor does not exist or is not available to this workspace.

items.description: A CheckRunSummary returned by the existing API.
